title: Medical English 10-11
category: Medical & Dental Questions > Medical English Question

questions.question: In which of the following sentences the word 'Bring' is used to mean in bangla 'ঘটানো'?
options: He tried to bring about a quarrel between them.
The good harvest brought down the price of rice.
His property brings him in Taka 500000/- a year.
She is brought up by her mother
questions.explanation: Bring about- ঘটানো, bring down -কমানো, bring up- লালন পালন করা।

questions.question: Which of the following words is 'Verb + Adverb'?
questions.explanation: How শব্দটি adverb এবং know শব্দটি verb. Option A তে, hold verb, all pronoun; option B তে, hear - verb, say - verb; option D তে, make verb, up- preposition.

questions.question: Which of the following is active with verbal noun with preposition & object?
options: I saw him go to the garden
Amina and Joy made us laugh
We went to see the launching of the ship
I am to make a telephone call
questions.explanation: The + noun (verb + ing/ment etc) + of কে verbal noun বলে।

questions.question: Which of the following words is a verb?
questions.explanation: Glorify শব্দটি glory (Noun) শব্দের verb. Idiocy (noun) চরম বুদ্ধিহীনতা; joyously (adverb) উৎফুল্লের সহিত; horrible (adjective) - ভয়ঙ্কর।

questions.question: Which of the following sentences is passive with reflexive object?
options: He was elected President by them
You are requested to go there.
questions.explanation: Self/selves যুক্ত pronoun গুলোকে সাধারণত reflexive pronoun বলা হয়। যেমন: himself, herself, itself, themselves, ourselves, yourself/ yourselves etc.

questions.question: Which of the following pairs is correct to express in a single word in বাংলা for a group of word?
options: Not bearing the name of a writer: সর্বজ্ঞ
One leaving his native country to settle in another: অভিবাসী
questions.explanation: One leaving his native country to settle in another অর্থ যে নিজ দেশ ত্যাগ করে অন্য দেশে বসতি স্থাপন করে অভিবাসী বলে।

questions.question: Which of the followings is the correct English translation of that Bangla sentence?
options: তুমি কি খুঁজছ?: What are you looking for?
আমি গ্রামে বাস করি: I live within village.
আমি ছেলেটিকে একটি বই দিয়েছিলাম: I give a book to the boy.
তুমি কোথা থেকে আসছ?: Where does you come from?
questions.explanation: Village-এর আগে within বসে না, in বসে। C-তে tense ঠিক নেই, D-তে you (sub)-এর আগে does না বসে do বসবে।

questions.question: Which of the following prepositions will be the appropriate replacement of the underlined preposition to correct this sentence? 'We all thirst (over) happiness?'
Which of the followings is the correct English translation of the Bangla word 'বতর'?
questions.explanation: বাংলা 'বতর' শব্দটি দ্বারা সঠিক সময় কে নির্দেশ করা হয়। এর ইংরেজি অর্থ due time, proper time, right time.

questions.question: Which of the following words is the correct synonym of 'Libel'?
questions.explanation: Libel শব্দের অর্থ মানহানিকর বিবৃতি বা রচনা। এর সমার্থক শব্দ হবে misrepresentation Convincing শব্দের অর্থ বিশ্বাসযোগ্য; annihilate শব্দের অর্থ সম্পূর্ণ ধ্বংস করা; enervated শব্দের অর্থ শারীরিক ও মানসিকভাবে দুর্বল করা।

questions.question: Which of the following words is a noun?
questions.explanation: Richochet - বুলেট/শব্দ মাটি/ দেয়ালে লেগে ফিরে আসা; পুনরাবৃত্তি। Ordain - ভাগ্য স্থির হওয়া, imprimatur- অনুমোদন, মঞ্জুরি; pontificate-  নিজেকে জাহির করা।

questions.question: Which of the following words is a verb?
questions.explanation: Retch (v)- বমির ভাব হওয়া; rectitude (Noun)- নৈতিক সততা, সরলতা, সাধুতা; reconnoiter যে ব্যক্তি রাত্রে ক্যাম্প পাহারা দেয়; retardant (adj) -নিরোধক; মানসিক প্রতিবন্ধী।

questions.question: Which of the following words is the correct English translation of the bangla word 'প্রতিমাননা'?
questions.explanation: Corroborative সত্য বলে দৃঢ়ভাবে সমর্থনযোগ্য; transliteration = প্রতিবর্ণীকরণ/অক্ষরীকরণ। Homage = শ্রদ্ধাজ্ঞাপন, প্রতিমাননা।

questions.question: Which of the followings is the incorrect English?
options: The chairman was gracious enough to give us a dinner
These fruits are eatable but those are poisonous
She was badly injured by my unkind words.
questions.explanation: Injured অর্থ কোনো দূর্ঘটনায় আঘাত পাওয়া; (C)-তে কারও কথার দ্বারা আঘাত পাওয়া বা কষ্ট পাওয়া বুঝাতে hurt by হবে।

questions.question: Which of sentences has the correct use of preposition?
options: He was born in a village at the district of Sirajgong
He usually goes to bed in 11 O'clock
You can't buy it at such price
We were sitting into his bedroom
questions.explanation: District-এর আগে in বসবে। নির্দিষ্ট সময়ের পূর্বে at বসে। কোনো কিছুর মধ্যে বোঝাতে (স্থির) in বসে।
